headline: 泰勒絲凱爾西紐約完婚
context: 歌手泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）與美式足球球星特拉維斯・凱爾西（Travis Kelce）於 7 月 4 日在紐約麥迪遜廣場花園（Madison Square Garden）舉行婚禮。賓客包括 Gigi Hadid 和布萊德利・庫柏（Bradley Cooper），亞當・山德勒（Adam Sandler）擔任主婚人。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Singer and fiance Travis Kelce have been coy but festivities are getting under way at Madison Square Garden The streets of New York City and the first-class lounges of Heathrow and JFK airports were crawling on Friday with celebrities on their way to attend the wedding of the year. Taylor Swift had kept fans guessing about whether it was her nuptials that had caused the closure of 11 streets in midtown Manhattan and the endless deliveries of flowers, food and decorations to the huge Madison Square Garden arena. Continue reading...
sources.title: Stars assemble in New York City amid preparations for Taylor Swift 4 July wedding

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The couple invited an array of celebrity guests to the wedding, including Gigi Hadid and Bradley Cooper, while Adam Sandler officiated their nuptials In pictures: Fans and A-list stars gather for the wedding Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are officially wed. The couple hosted their wedding celebration on Friday in New York City, nearly three years after first meeting. The ceremony was officiated by Adam Sandler, a Swift spokesperson said in a Friday statement confirming the nuptials. Continue reading...

thread_text:
泰勒絲凱爾西紐約完婚

歌手泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）與美式足球球星特拉維斯・凱爾西（Travis Kelce）於 7 月 4 日在紐約麥迪遜廣場花園（Madison Square Garden）舉行婚禮。賓客包括 Gigi Hadid 和布萊德利・庫柏（Bradley Cooper），喜劇演員亞當・山德勒（Adam Sandler）擔任主婚人。婚禮在室內低調進行，廣場外聚集了大批歌迷。

—— 本則來自《衛報》與《紐約時報》，2026 年 7 月 4 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
歌手泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）與美式足球球星特拉維斯・凱爾西（Travis Kelce）於 7 月 4 日在紐約麥迪遜廣場花園（Madison Square Garden）舉行婚禮。賓客包括 Gigi Hadid 和布萊德利・庫柏（Bradley Cooper），亞當・山德勒（Adam Sandler）擔任主婚人。婚禮雖在室內低調進行，廣場外依舊聚集了不少歌迷。

本則整理自《衛報》與《紐約時報》於 2026 年 7 月 4 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 泰勒絲結婚了。她和特拉維斯・凱爾西在紐約麥迪遜廣場花園完婚，賓客包括 Gigi Hadid 和布萊德利・庫柏，亞當・山德勒擔任主婚人。婚禮在室內低調進行，廣場外還是聚集了大批歌迷。
